notes: Every combat brigade (HBCT, IBCT, Marine RCT) gets its own area of operations; add a brigade and the country is redrawn into one more sector
Maneuver companies only patrol, assault and raid inside their brigade's AO; artillery can still fire across boundaries when called for support
Units finishing a mission report to a base inside their AO instead of driving back across the country
Each brigade sets its headquarters at a base in its AO, which gets a tactical assembly area (+6 unit slots) so the brigade fits
Cohesion bonus now counts the whole AO: bases anywhere in the sector keep the +15%
New Order of battle screen: brigade cards with AO, strength, cohesion and where every company is, plus division & theater troops by role
